narrative_shape: Silent Bash/Read loop from the first checkpoint. The same five parser files (_cenc.c, divide.py, _e2.c, build_alldata.py, osm_to_parcel_geometry.py) are re-read while compactions climb from 12 to 40 and assistant text stays frozen at 36 characters until past turn 210. The histogram never gains Edit or Write. A few short lines after turn 236 (tidy comments, add ctests, amendment while gates run) sit inside that same loop.

phases.name: reread/bash loop
phases.note: Already dominant at turn 75: _cenc.c×10, divide.py×7, _e2.c×6, 12 compactions, empty tail. Through 120, bash 55→94, no new paths, text still 36, distinct reads stuck at 7.

phases.name: same loop, no new files
phases.note: Reread counts and compactions keep rising. delta_new_reads stays empty. Read grows only on the same paths. Outcome of the early loop, not a new phase.

phases.name: bash gates with scraps of prose
phases.note: Read count freezes at 81. Turns 236, 266, 270, and 284 are one-line test/amendment notes between silent Bash calls. One Monitor appears only at 279.

early_signals.signal: Reread cluster already set (_cenc.c 10, divide.py 7, _e2.c 6) with 12 compactions, assistant text 36 characters, and a silent Read/Bash tail.
Bash +15, no new read paths, text still 36, compactions 14.
Same files, higher reread counts (_cenc.c 13), still no new paths.
Bash 94 vs Read 47, compactions 20, distinct reads still 7, text still 36.

earliness: on time — the first checkpoint is already the loop, and later checkpoints only continue it
rationale: Turn 75 already shows a non-progressing reread and compaction loop with no edits and no prose. Turns 90–120 intensify that loop. Anything after 120 is the same outcome.
